scope: Ki Blast Super catalog — mentor, shop, PQ, and tournament records

records.name: Death Slicer
records.effect: Throws a tracking purple Ki disc; a follow-up input redirects it toward the opponent.

records.name: Ki Blast Cannon
records.effect: Unblockable shockwave-like Ki blast that can re-stand or stagger opponents and can be repeated without additional Ki.

records.name: Dodon Ray
records.effect: Very fast, low-damage fingertip beam that launches and permits immediate movement/continuation.

records.name: Death Slash
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 23 - The Explosion of Namek
records.effect: Fast short-range blade-shaped Ki wave that lingers briefly and launches the opponent.

records.name: Burst Attack
records.unlock_method: Shenron wish - I want a new Super Attack!
records.effect: Tracking flaming Ki ball that creates a lingering fire pillar and launches the target.

records.name: Kairos Cannon
records.unlock_method: Conton City Tournament Match 2 — "Thinning the Herd"
records.effect: Sets up Ki projectiles that automatically fire; additional input can release accumulated projectiles together.

reconciliation_note: Reconciled against current Xenoverse 2-specific references and the repository's existing cross-domain evidence. Death Slicer, Ki Blast Cannon, Dodon Ray, Death Slash, and Burst Attack retain their established Super/Ki Blast identities and acquisition endpoints. Kairos Cannon is corrected from character-only to Future Warrior/CaC-accessible: current evidence identifies it as a Supreme Kai of Time Super/Ki Blast skill obtainable from Conton City Tournament Match 2 — Thinning the Herd. No canonical promotion was made because the supported lossless builder path remains unavailable.
